name: Review Database Migration Plan
summary: Review a database migration plan for explicit SQL hazards and an evidenced rollout, rollback, lock, and backfill plan.
description: Review a proposed database schema or data migration before it is executed by separating deterministic high-confidence SQL hazards from contextual rollout, rollback, lock, and backfill judgment. Use when a migration plan or SQL change needs review.
risk_reason: This skill reviews a database migration plan for explicit SQL hazards and an evidenced rollout, rollback, lock, and backfill plan; it does not execute SQL, apply a migration, or approve a production change.
refuses: It does not execute SQL, apply a migration, or approve a production change.
It does not infer table size, lock duration, engine behavior, or rollback feasibility from SQL alone.
It does not turn an absent rollback, backup, or owner into an assumed safety control.

entrypoints.purpose: Classify only explicit, high-confidence SQL risk patterns from a bounded local file and emit JSON.

operational.latency_reason: The skill reviews a database migration plan for explicit SQL hazards and an evidenced rollout, rollback, lock, and backfill plan, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
